description: Enhanced Real-Time Features - Extend Socket.IO service with targeted emit helpers, add claim notification events, create SocketContext for client-side management, enable real-time updates in Dashboard and MyClaims
steps: Extend server/src/services/socketService.js with emitToUser(userId, event, data) and emitToRestaurant(restaurantId, event, data) helper functions
Update server/src/controllers/claimController.js to emit claim:created to restaurant owner's room when claim is made, emit claim:status_updated to claimant's room on status changes
Verify server/src/controllers/foodController.js emits food:status_changed event with listingId + new status on food updates
Create client/src/context/SocketContext.jsx that connects socket.io-client on login with JWT token from localStorage, exposes socket instance, disconnects on logout
Update client/src/App.jsx to wrap application with SocketContext provider
Add real-time claim notifications to client/src/pages/restaurant/Dashboard.jsx - listen for claim:created events to refresh recent claims
Add real-time status updates to client/src/pages/claims/MyClaims.jsx - listen for claim:status_updated events to update claim status in UI
acceptance_criteria: Socket service provides targeted messaging to specific users and restaurants
Claim creation triggers real-time notification to restaurant owner
Claim status changes trigger real-time updates to claimant's view
Restaurant dashboard shows new claims instantly without page refresh
MyClaims page updates claim status in real-time when changed by restaurant
verification: Test real-time notifications across multiple browser tabs with different user accounts
Create claim as NGO and verify restaurant receives instant notification
Update claim status as restaurant and verify claimant sees real-time update
Verify socket connection includes JWT authentication token
Check browser dev tools Network tab shows WebSocket connection with proper auth
